91: To uncover the ark in public - as long as the public [remains] in the synagogue, because it was their custom to bring the Torah scroll from another building, in which it was kept safe, to the synagogue. They would spread beautiful garments around the ark and place [the Torah scroll] inside it. When they would leave there and take the Torah scroll in order to bring it to the house where it was kept safe, they should not remove the garments from the ark in front of the congregation, since it is a burden to the congregation to be held there with the Torah scroll. Rather, one should take the Torah scroll to its house and place it there, and the public should follow him. Afterwards he comes and uncovers the ark.
